name: sigkill
description: Long enough (several seconds of delay_ms across steps) that a test can look up the live pid from state.json and SIGKILL it directly (or SIGKILL the runner's own pid) before the turn finishes, to exercise reconcile's process_error / orphaned / stale-lock-reclaim paths (docs/04 #9, #10) instead of a clean exit_code finalize.
